title: Vision chart extraction reliability
goal: Measure chart value extraction and trend reasoning without invented datapoints.
prompt: Use vision.analyze with mode chart, detail high, and output detailed. Return each quarter and value, then state the supported trend.
prerequisites: Configure and explicitly enable a vision-capable live route.
steps: Run the chart prompt against the deterministic fixture.
Score values and conclusions against manifest.json.
Record any unsupported claim as one hallucination.
assertions: Q1 through Q4 values are exact.
Q4 is identified as the maximum.
The response identifies a monotonic increase and invents no additional series.
notes: Accuracy percent uses the six expected manifest items.
